description.value: Panago Pizza is a Canadian pizza chain with a Williams Lake location situated just off Highway 97 at McKinnon Road and 10th Avenue North, near the Williams Lake Stampede Grounds. It offers a range of gourmet-inspired recipe pizzas alongside wings, salads, sides, and desserts, with an emphasis on quality ingredients including antibiotic-free meat and organic tomato sauce. For touring cyclists moving through the Cariboo, it is a convenient hot-meal stop in the north end of town.
